description: Key rotation (since 1.2). `chains`: give `chain` and `options` to the verifier; every fact `expect` lists must be as given (a verifier may report more; a key's `publicKey` is its SPKI PEM). `online`: the refusal a verifier applies online, `accept` or `refuse`. `recordHash`: a record's `prev` value, the SHA-256 of its signed object's RFC 8785 form in lowercase hex.

chains.name: the-same-key-under-a-new-selector-needs-no-record
chains.note: The domain moved s= to btps9 and re-published btps2's key under it: DNS at btps9 gives the chain's current fingerprint.

chains.name: a-rotation-without-the-new-keys-signature
chains.why: the new key proves its holder has it

chains.name: a-planned-rotation-signed-by-a-key-it-does-not-name
chains.why: the old key is the authority

chains.name: a-stated-fingerprint-that-is-not-the-keys
chains.why: a fingerprint is computed from the DER SPKI, never taken from the record

chains.name: a-key-under-2048-bits
chains.why: every key is RSA of at least 2048 bits

chains.name: a-wrong-type
chains.why: the signed type tag is btps.keyRotation.v1

chains.name: another-identitys-record
chains.why: a record's identity is the identity being resolved

chains.name: a-rotation-signed-by-current
chains.why: a rotation is signed by from and to

chains.name: a-broken-prev
chains.why: prev names the previous record's hash

chains.name: two-first-records
chains.why: only the first record has a null prev

chains.name: time-going-backwards
chains.why: each record's at is later than the previous one's

chains.name: a-b-a-under-a-second-stated-fingerprint
chains.why: a fingerprint is computed, so a key cannot pass as another

chains.name: a-reused-selector
chains.why: a selector names one key for the life of the identity

chains.name: an-expiry-not-signed-by-the-current-key
chains.why: the current key signs an expiry

chains.name: an-expiry-of-the-current-key
chains.why: the current key is expired by rotating it with immediate expiry

online.name: a-truncated-chain
online.why: it does not end at the key DNS publishes

online.name: a-chain-not-from-the-operator

online.name: a-forked-chain
